protocol: Reconstruct the reference recipe from the paper, its configuration repositories and their commit history. Follow cited code to the commit that produced the result.

Record each value as an evidence card with the fields claim, assertion_kind, quantity, value, uncertainty, conditions (each located or not_stated, including observed_or_expected), scope_not_covered, locator (document, unit, byte range and excerpt_sha256 of the verbatim excerpt), superseded_by and extractor.
Quote the source verbatim. Every number and unit on a card must appear in its located excerpt.
Record version statements as release or run, and say which.
List every value the public record does not establish as DATA in recipe_ledger_rows; never fill it from memory or convention.
Record upstream fixes to analysis code with commit and time.
Serve at most about five cards per decision; list the rest by ID.
Check every input, required output and inherited obligation against the pinned contract. Preserve failed and unresolved evidence.
card.purpose: Reconstruct the reference recipe from primary sources, their configuration repositories and commit history, as located evidence cards; separate measurement from speculation.
